_comment: How a deluge climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Its danger is slow to pay off -- a sea two hours from your door is a threat and not yet a hazard -- so
two of its three dials are cheap to have: `rate` is how fast the sea climbs while it rains and `downpour`
how much of the time it rains. All of it is harmful, since the sea takes ground.
`height` is how far over its written level the sea is carried; its last steps are failing, so only a
failing Age drowns to the build limit.
Leans wet, and needs a sea of water to raise (Jonah, 2026-10-19): a deluge of lava wants rain of its own
